notes.title: We just released version 1.15! 🎉
notes.content: [p]We've just released a new update for Delta Light 2! This patch focuses on improvements to our Infinite Mode, visual and audio polish for the turbo, adjustments to in-game popups, and lays important groundwork for future content.[/p][p][/p][h3]Infinite Mode - Unique & Replayable Maps[/h3][p]Infinite Mode now generates maps based on your Steam ID, ensuring that your maps are unique to everyone else's. [/p][p]But should you wish to revisit a particular map, you can do so by selecting it again. [/p][p]In this patch we added some brief introductory textboxes when first entering Infinite Mode to clarify this system.[/p][p][/p][h3]Turbo - Visual & Audio Polish[/h3][p]We've made some adjustments to the turbo effect to enhance its feedback. Expect a bit more  flair with refined particle effects and sound effects when engaging and disengaging your turbo.[/p][p][/p][h3]UI Polish - Popup Timing Adjustments[/h3][p]We've fine-tuned the duration of various in-game popups. Most smaller popups will now last a bit shorter to reduce on-screen clutter, while larger, more significant notifications will retain their original display time.[/p][p][/p][h3]Under the Hood Preparations[/h3][p]This patch also includes some foundational code that supports upcoming features. While not immediately visible, these behind-the-scenes updates are important steps towards future content releases.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing.[/p][p]We <3 your support.[/p][p]~Veldin[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: We just released version 1.14! 🎉
notes.content: [p]The base price of the game has been lowered from $7.99 to $3.99. [/p][p]This does not affect anyone who already owns the game, but we hope the lower price makes it easier for new players to jump in.[/p][p][/p][p]Now for people who actualy play![/p][h2]Level balance:[/h2][p]The first two levels of Chapter 5 (5-1 & 5-2) have been adjusted. [/p][p]The jump in difficulty from Chapter 4 to 5 was sharper than intended.[/p][p]We removed some smaller enemies, making it less overwelming. We want players to keep the focus on the larger, more important mobs.[/p][h2]Menu changes[/h2][p]Menus can now be navigated with the scroll wheel when using mouse and keyboard, making them easier to use.[/p][h2]Character balance:[/h2][p]We changed the starting health of some of our characters;[/p][p][/p][p][b]Eve:[/b] Her “speed up when hit” playstyle was too risky and we felt it rarely paid off. [/p][p]So she now starts with one extra health to make her style more rewarding and we hope more fun to play.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Melon:[/b] Intended to be our tanky boy, but we feel they were too fragile early on. [/p][p]Melon now starts with two more health to better fulfill that TANK role.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Speedy Boi:[/b] Was the most common pick, we felt he was overshadowing other characters.[/p][p]So he now starts with one less health. His speed remains the same though. But he now is more fragile, encouraging variety in character choice.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459041/b25288d2a971ee3822fa4299d0a2402a7037e74d.png"][/img][/p][p] Thanks again for sticking with us, we can’t wait to see what you think of this new patch! <3 <3 <3[/p][h2][/h2]

notes.title: Delta Light 2 - DEMO
notes.content:
Delta Light 2 is a fast-paced arcade action puzzle game. The demo lets you play through the entire first act, giving you a full taste of what the game has to offer without any commitment.

Based on the feedback we’ve received, we realized that many people weren’t sure what to expect from Delta Light 2

And while Delta Light 2 look still draws inspiration from classic browser games. it’s a take on what those games could have evolved into if we were to take them further. This demo exists so you can try it out for yourself. 

It’s an easy way to see what the game feels like, how it plays, and whether it’s something you want to dive deeper into. 

You don’t have to know Delta Light 1 to enjoy this, and you’re not expected to. This is a new game, and the demo is the best way to discover what makes it stand out.

Want to make sure Delta Light 2 runs smoothly on your machine? The demo lets you test our custom-built c++ engine before committing to the full game.

Thanks to everyone who’s played, shared thoughts, or even just taken a look at Delta Light . Seriously, it means a lot. Making this game has been a long and personal journey

This demo is a direct result of that feedback. It’s my way of saying, “here’s the game, see what you think.” No pressure, no pitch, just a chance to feel it for yourself.

notes.title: We just released version 1.13! 🎉
notes.content:
With the launch of Update 1.13, Delta Light 2 now features a new Arcade Mode specially designed for Arcade setups (and speedrunning).

When booting up the game from Steam, you will now be greeted with choice to run the game as-is or start up in 'Arcade' mode.

When starting Arcade mode, a single-button splash screen invites your players to sit down and start playing right away. Arcade Mode strips the game down to its core, focusing entirely on the action.

Arcade Mode not only skips all (VN) dialog, but also resets everything after each session. That means scores, levels, and character unlocks all return to zero state when quitting to the main menu. Progress is not saved, in true arcade fashion.

To keep the experience focused and uninterrupted, both the level select and quit buttons are hidden during Arcade Mode gameplay.

For those who love to speedrun, our built-in timer (press T to activate) works just as well in Arcade Mode as it does in the default mode. No manual resets needed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459041/0b70688fce48d92de61c436fb1da37d8f14f24d0.png[/img]

We've also made a few small life improvements. For example, you can now use the mouse to mute or unmute the game and toggle fullscreen on and off more easily. Just move the cursor to the top of the screen during gameplay to reveal a quick-access bar with those essential icons.

This is our first big-big update since our launch in march and I've loved all your lovely comments and interactions with me and the game. Thanks for sticking with us, we can’t wait to see what you think of this new mode! <3 <3 <3

notes.title: We just released version 1.12 on Steam! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We just released version 1.12 on Steam! 🎉

This is our second patch since launch, and once again, it's based on your feedback—thank you!

🔹 Improved Score Screen

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459041/30565f0dee2363d2f1480f43259a3a9ba3e530c1.png[/img]

When you finish a map, your score is added to your total score. This can take a while, but you can press Enter to speed it up. To make this clearer, we’ve added a visual effect and sound cue when boosting the count.

If you decide to wait, a message will now appear letting you know when it’s time to press Continue. No more long waits like Javid — https://youtu.be/4hzqmEqHSPY?t=519

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459041/22ae839778b6cd556ef7443a935a6490532bc27c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459041/3a683bdc59a371fac83bbe44d087701f58295aa9.png[/img][/url]

Sorry about that! 😅 Loved the showcase tho! Thank you <3

🔹 Smoother Menu Navigation - Key-repeat

Our second improvement this patch is the key-repeat. You can now hold Up/Down on the D-pad or arrow keys to scroll through menus, instead of tapping repeatedly.

Enjoy the update, and happy gaming! 🚀

notes.title: We just released version 1.11! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We just released version 1.11 on Steam! 🎉

This is our first post-release patch, addressing minor corrections and improvements based on user feedback.

The achievements for Stage 2-7 and Stage 5-5 were not triggering correctly. This issue has been resolved.

We also added a way to quickly select characters on the character select screen by pressing the number keys 1 through 6, with 1 being the first character and 6 the last.

Lastly, we added a README to the installation folder with essential information on game installation, controls, and save data management.

Enjoy the update, and happy gaming! 🚀

notes.title: We just released Delta light 2 💜
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

This is it, the official release version of Delta Light 2! It’s been an incredible journey, and in many ways, it’s only just beginning.

As of today, the game is officially available to the general public!

In this patch, we’ve addressed the last bits of weirdness with achievement triggering and Infinite Mode map generation to ensure a smoother experience.

As this is the release version, I want to extend a huge thank you to everyone who contributed to this game—those who helped with testing, those who played it before release, and everyone who provided feedback and support. Special thanks to Rolemusic for making his music available, the OLC Discord community for their encouragement, and Bixxy for all his hard work on the engine side of things.

Now, all that’s left to say is:
Enjoy Deta Light 2, and happy gaming! 🚀

notes.title: We just released pre-release version 1.09! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We just released pre-release version 1.09 on Steam! 🎉

You can now display in-game speedrun timers using the new Mini Timers feature. These timers automatically start and stop for each campaign stage and track your total run time. You can toggle them on or off using the 'T' key on the keyboard or R3 on the controller.

We’ve also added a way to quickly select chapters when starting a new game. Simply use the number keys 1 through 9, with 1 being the first chapter and 9 the last.

Additionally, we’ve adjusted some menu animation speeds to make navigation feel smoother and more responsive.

Enjoy the update, and happy gaming! 🚀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459041/f6a6619955645c78c3b0bd711e3460e1f8ec2aa1.png[/img]

notes.title: We just released pre-release version 1.08! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We just released pre-release version 1.08 on Steam! 🎉

This update brings refinements to dynamic visual effects, with a particular focus on the CRT filter—now toned down overall but applied more dynamically in various boss battles and key moments.

We've also improved scene transitions, character unlocking effects, and enemy-specific visuals for a smoother and more immersive experience.

Additionally, the Static Charger enemy has been adjusted: its charging attack will now always complete if it reaches 66% charge or higher.

Enjoy the update, and happy gaming! 🚀

notes.title: We just released pre-release version 1.07! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We just released pre-release version 1.07 on Steam! 🎉

This update includes some text adjustments and fixes for achievements that weren’t triggering properly before. Now, when you launch the game with the new patch, achievements related to character unlocking, score, and tile progression should unlock correctly if you met the requirements in the past.

We’ve also rebalanced certain achievements by adjusting the required score and tiles cleared requirements for a better gameplay experience.

Additionally, this update improves achievement tracking for those who play offline occasionally.

Happy gaming! 🚀
